title: MetadataVersion
description: Immutable snapshot envelope for a page save (ADR-006, BE-17, SCRUM-20). New save creates a new record; existing versions are not updated or deleted. schemaVersion is the metadata contract version for future evolution.

id.description: UUID identifier (ADR-005, STD-35). Server-generated on save.

pageId.description: Owning Page id (SCRUM-20 envelope, T-12). Matches /api/v1/pages/{pageId}/metadata (BE-15).

version.description: Monotonic version number per page (T-12, ADR-006).

schemaVersion.description: Phase 1 metadata JSON contract version (T-12 example, SCRUM-20). This schema file accepts only 1.0.0; a later contract gets a new schema (or an updated const).

isCurrent.description: Atomically maintained latest-version flag (BE-17, T-12). Server-managed on save.

snapshot.description: Immutable copy of the page's components and apiBindings at save time (T-12, ADR-006).

createdDate.description: Set by JPA @CreatedDate (STD-24). SCRUM-20 envelope name createdAt maps to this Java/JSON field. Not client-supplied.

createdBy.description: Username from AuditorAware / JWT (STD-23, SCRUM-20 envelope). Not client-supplied.

lastModifiedDate.description: Set by JPA @LastModifiedDate (STD-24). On an immutable version this should match createdDate.

lastModifiedBy.description: Set by JPA @LastModifiedBy (STD-24). On an immutable version this should match createdBy.
